اغتربنا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَرَبْنَا (iḡtarabnā) /iɣ.ta.rab.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# اُغْتُرِبْنَا (uḡturibnā) /uɣ.tu.rib.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
